data.purpose: Retrieve visit preparation data for an outlet including open consignment cycles, product information, geofence radius, and financial snapshots (HPP and price) visible only to owner role.

and: Response includes outlet details
Response includes geofence_radius_m from app_settings (default 100)
Response includes cycles array with age_hours and color indicators (green < 72h, yellow 72-96h, red >= 96h)
hpp_snapshot and price_snapshot only included when user.role === 'owner'
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:read permission and existing outlet
scenarios.name: Load visit data for outlet
scenarios.then: 200 OK with outlet, geofence_radius_m, and cycles array
scenarios.when: GET /outlets/:id/visit is called with valid outlet ID

and: Outlet must have deleted_at IS NULL
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:read permission
scenarios.name: Outlet not found
scenarios.then: 404 NOT_FOUND error with message 'Warung tidak ditemukan'
scenarios.when: GET /outlets/:id/visit is called with non-existent or deleted outlet ID

data.purpose: Process a visit for an outlet including pickups (cycle returns with sold/good/damaged quantities), drops (new product consignments), geofence validation with optional override, and idempotency protection.

and: Idempotency key prevents duplicate processing
Geofence validation uses client_lat, client_lng, client_accuracy_m against outlet location and geofence_radius_m
geofence_override allows bypassing location check with geofence_override_reason
Financial data in result only included for owner role
Returns 201 Created on success
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:write permission, valid outlet, and properly formed visit payload
scenarios.name: Successful visit processing
scenarios.then: 201 Created with VisitResult (financial data only for owners)
scenarios.when: POST /outlets/:id/visit is called with valid visit data

and: Validation errors include Indonesian error messages
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:write permission
scenarios.name: Invalid request body
scenarios.then: ValidationError with concatenated error messages
scenarios.when: POST /outlets/:id/visit is called with missing/invalid fields

and: Outlet must not be soft-deleted
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:write permission
scenarios.name: Outlet not found
scenarios.then: 404 NOT_FOUND error with message 'Warung tidak ditemukan'
scenarios.when: POST /outlets/:id/visit is called with non-existent or deleted outlet ID

data.purpose: Void (cancel/reverse) a previously processed visit by its idempotency key, requiring a reason for the void action.

and: Void operation reverses all financial and inventory effects of the original visit
Idempotency key identifies the original visit to void
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:void permission and existing processed visit
scenarios.name: Successful visit void
scenarios.then: 200 OK with { ok: true }
scenarios.when: POST /visits/:idempotencyKey/void is called with valid reason

and: Reason is required with minimum 1 character
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with visit:void permission
scenarios.name: Missing void reason
scenarios.then: ValidationError with message 'Alasan pembatalan wajib diisi'
scenarios.when: POST /visits/:idempotencyKey/void is called without reason or empty reason

data.purpose: Retrieve visit preparation data for a specific outlet, including active cycles, geofence radius, and outlet details. *(analyzed in 3 chunks)*

and: Response includes cycles array with product details and quantities
Response includes geofence_radius_m for location validation
Response includes outlet object with coordinates
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with valid outletId
scenarios.name: Load visit form data
scenarios.then: 200 OK with visit preparation data

data.purpose: Submit a completed visit with pickup quantities, new drops, GPS location, and optional geofence override. *(analyzed in 3 chunks)*

and: Validates GPS coordinates are within geofence radius or override is provided
Validates cycle pickup quantities sum correctly (good + damaged + sold = dropped)
Uses idempotency key to prevent duplicate submissions
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with valid visit form data and GPS lock
scenarios.name: Submit valid visit
scenarios.then: 200 OK with success confirmation

and: Requires user.role === 'owner' for override
Requires overrideReason when override is true
scenarios.given: Owner user outside geofence radius
scenarios.name: Submit with geofence override
scenarios.then: 200 OK with success confirmation

and: Error message returned in response body
Client stores draft for retry when network error detected
scenarios.given: User with completed form
scenarios.name: Submit fails with network error
scenarios.then: Network error caught, draft preserved, error shown to user
scenarios.when: POST /api/outlets/{outletId}/visit fails due to no connectivity

data.purpose: Retrieve visit form data including outlet details, active stock cycles, and available products for a specific visit. *(analyzed in 3 chunks)*

and: Outlet details include name and address
Active cycles include product name, color, and dropped quantity

scenarios.given: Authenticated user with valid visit ID
scenarios.name: Load visit form data
scenarios.then: 200 OK with visit details, cycles, and products

and: Error message displayed: 'Gagal memuat data kunjungan'
Loading state is cleared
scenarios.given: Authenticated user with invalid or non-existent visit ID
scenarios.name: Visit not found
scenarios.then: 404 Not Found with error message

and: Error message: 'Tidak ada jaringan. Draft tersimpan — kirim ulang saat online.'
Form shows offline indicator
scenarios.given: User is offline
scenarios.name: Offline data loading
scenarios.then: Error displayed with offline guidance
scenarios.when: GET /api/visits/:id fails due to network error

data.purpose: Submit visit form with stock pickups, new stock drops, GPS location, and optional geofence override for owner role. *(analyzed in 3 chunks)*

and: GPS coordinates are captured with accuracy
Geofence validation checks distance against outlet radius
Stock pickups validate good + damaged + sold equals dropped quantity
scenarios.given: Authenticated user within geofence radius with valid form data
scenarios.name: Submit visit successfully
scenarios.then: 200 OK with success message, redirect to visit list
scenarios.when: POST /api/visits/:id with valid pickups, drops, and GPS

and: Override checkbox is shown only for owner role
Override reason is required when override is enabled
Distance validation is bypassed when override is active
scenarios.given: Authenticated owner user outside geofence radius
scenarios.name: Owner override geofence
scenarios.then: 200 OK with override reason recorded

and: Non-owner users cannot see override option
Form shows error: 'Anda di luar radius kunjungan'
scenarios.given: Authenticated non-owner user outside geofence radius
scenarios.name: Non-owner outside geofence
scenarios.then: 400 Bad Request with geofence violation error

and: Validation error: 'Sisa layak + rusak + terjual harus {qty_dropped}'
Invalid pickup fields highlighted in red
scenarios.given: User with invalid stock pickup quantities
scenarios.name: Invalid pickup quantities
scenarios.then: 400 Bad Request with validation error
scenarios.when: POST /api/visits/:id with pickup totals not matching dropped

and: Draft saved locally with timestamp
Offline banner shown: 'Tidak ada jaringan. Draft tersimpan di HP — kirim ulang saat online & dalam radius.'
Submit button remains enabled for retry
scenarios.given: User is offline with valid form data
scenarios.name: Offline form submission
scenarios.then: Network error handled, draft preserved for later sync
scenarios.when: POST /api/visits/:id fails due to no connectivity

and: Error message: 'Gagal menyimpan kunjungan.'
Form remains editable with current values
scenarios.given: Server error during submission
scenarios.name: Server error on submit
scenarios.then: 500 Internal Server Error with user-friendly message
